svg.title: Interior contract curve — Alice and Benjamin
svg.desc: The interior efficient set has Alice's good 2 equal to 1: one unit above her bottom-left origin, equivalently two units below Benjamin's top-right origin. Three unlabelled illustrative tangencies lie on this horizontal dashed line. Good 1 ranges strictly between 0 and 5 for Alice. Hollow endpoints are excluded. No point E, chosen good-1 quantity, endowment or unique equilibrium is shown.
